newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares continue upward, way ahead uncertain.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares continue upward, way ahead uncertain.

text.p: Danish share prices closed higher in a positive market on Thursday, with dealers unsure about the outlook but saying it very much depended on the expiry of the KFX September future on Friday.
"The market undertone was optimistic today, but whether we continue up or fall back is all up to how tomorrow's KFX September future expiry goes," one dealer said.

The KFX top-20 index closed 0.30 point up at 122.10 in overall bourse turnover of 1.126 billion crowns. The KFX September future rose 0.25 point to 122.00 with 3,557 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
Solid rises for Rentokil in London spawned a 13 crown rise for part-owner Sophus Berendsen, which finished at 725.
ISS continued upwards, putting on six crowns to finish at 149, with foreign investors showing great interest.
Novo Nordisk had a less good day, ending one crown down at 896 after hitting 902 at one point.
